name: Atlassian Rovo and Teamwork Graph
tier_reason: Work-graph competitor over Jira/Confluence, the reference IT-engineering sources
latest_version: SaaS rolling (no version); Rovo MCP Server v2
release_cadence: Continuous SaaS; major announcements at Team events (Team '26 on 2026-05-06)
license: Proprietary SaaS subscription; Rovo included in Standard/Premium/Enterprise Cloud plans with credit allowances
redistribution_notes: No OEM, white-label or embedding rights found; Forge/Marketplace data restrictions apply to connectors.
legal_review_reason: Proprietary terms; consumption pricing; Forge connector data-class prohibitions; not a redistributable component
community_vs_enterprise: Plan-dependent features (Studio, governance, some connectors reported Premium/Enterprise); Teamwork Collection has larger credit pools
resolution_note: Shipped vs announced: Forge connectors, Studio and Jira agents GA per press; Teamwork Graph CLI and MCP tools open beta; Max mode early access; governance dashboards announced without status. Data Center EOL 2029-03-28; DC gets connectors that push to Cloud only. Seed inversion partially validated: SaaS/air-gap limits validated, 'heavyweight' rejected, lock-in mechanism unproven.
decision_summary: REJECT as dependency; BUILD Atlassian DC/Cloud ingest with ACL parity; adopt connector capability declaration and ingestion-mode taxonomy; EXPERIMENT with principal-bound MCP scope

name: Onyx (formerly Danswer)
tier_reason: Closest open-source self-hosted enterprise-search / permissioned RAG competitor
release_cadence: Minor release roughly every 2 weeks (v4.4.0 2026-07-21 to v5.0.0 2026-10-23); Helm chart releases separately
license: MIT (Expat) outside ee directories; Onyx Enterprise License for content under ee directories (text not read in full)
redistribution_notes: MIT part appears redistributable; EE code, permission sync, SSO and white-label are Enterprise-gated; trademark use unreviewed.
legal_review_reason: Open-core split with proprietary ee directories; white-label and on-premise listed as Enterprise plan features; EE toggle in same codebase
community_vs_enterprise: CE: core RAG, chat, agents, connectors. EE: Auto Sync Permissions for 14 connectors, OIDC/SAML SSO, white-labelling, hook extensions, data exports
resolution_note: Renamed from Danswer. Vespa removed in 5.0 (OpenSearch sole index since v4.0.0); MinIO retired for SeaweedFS; KG pipeline variables ignored in 5.0, no KG docs page found. Seed 'Palantir/Glean/Rovo SaaS' hypothesis does not apply to Onyx.
decision_summary: BUILD ACL-in-retrieval using Onyx pattern; EXPERIMENT using Onyx hybrid as the strong non-graph baseline; REJECT EE code as dependency; DEFER KG copying

name: Cognee
tier_reason: Memory/KG pipeline competitor with dataset ACLs and forget semantics
release_cadence: Multiple releases per week to fortnight, frequent breaking changes
redistribution_notes: Permissive with patent grant; transitive dependencies (Ladybug/Kuzu, GLiNER weights, Fastembed models) not checked; Cognee Cloud is separate commercial.
legal_review_reason: Transitive dependency and model-weight licences unreviewed; telemetry default unverified
community_vs_enterprise: Open-source engine vs hosted Cognee Cloud with team dataset permissions; no feature gating inside the OSS engine found
resolution_note: Default graph engine now Ladybug (renamed Kuzu); docs partly still say Kuzu. Pipeline vocabulary moved from add/cognify/memify/search to remember/recall/improve/forget; memify() deprecated; temporal_cognify removed in 1.6.3. Seed hypothesis on LLM extraction cost partially validated: 2 LLM calls per chunk by default, keyless GLiNER path exists.
decision_summary: BUILD memory ACL/tenant/forget in EOIP using Cognee patterns; EXPERIMENT GLiNER extractor and optional vector modules; DEFER Cognee as runtime dependency
